scope: same original Base, fixed layer, single order, no rank/LR/seed search
current_edit_loss: .25 native + .25 cyclic admitted same-image FIT + .5 cyclic admitted cross-image GFIT
protection: same admitted BASIS, KL(Base || current), weight 1; evaluation labels unavailable to training

interventions.C: full initial Base right nullspace, fixed; no RLS, no gate, no history CE
interventions.U: unrestricted original W gradient; no RLS, no gate, no history CE
interventions.H: U plus .25 cyclic past native CE + .25 cyclic past GFIT CE; first edit identical to U

history: all previously inserted admitted owners, sorted by owner/query_id; one native and one GFIT cyclic sample at every step; no success-based selection
norm_schedule: C first, without final/held evaluation or Judge feedback; store actual FP32 norm per committed step; U/H consume exactly those targets bound to C owner/step/version
positive_target_zero_direction: terminal failure, not silent skip or retune

contrasts.geometry: U minus C at shared norms
contrasts.history_supervision: H minus U at shared norms

data_gate: source-bound legitimate edit requests and explicit train/evaluation role separation; no old error-derived labels. New cross-case clinical claims require new qualified evidence, but that evidence is not a prerequisite for a benchmark mechanism pilot.
evaluation: per-edit source/FIT/GFIT insertion and later-prefix retention; separately same-image unseen questions and cross-image unseen questions; old96 protection and original Base-correct subset; independent new protection when admitted; full denominators and missing-aware bounds
success: no compensation across owners; source/anchors correct at insertion and all later prefixes, no loss of Base-correct unseen or protected answers; same native parameter keys/shapes/count, fresh native reload, no inference editing branch; missing required scores prevents success
pending_before_formal_freeze: map chosen existing-source edit requests, training supervision and evaluation roles; distinguish mechanism pilot from an independently qualified new cohort
first-install finite deadline and storage lifecycle
retain_history: rounds1/2/3 immutable, accepted exact scores reused only by full binding; old missing scores retained
scientific_claim: DEV mechanism adaptation, not clinical/SOTA confirmation or complete author reproduction
scope_review_correction: 24 new units and two additional cross-image anchors per new unit are proposed stronger-evidence design choices, not requirements imposed by M3Bench or pure-W C/U/H. Extra clinical-transfer claims still require corresponding evidence.
H_supervision_boundary: past already-admitted edit requests and previously declared training anchors only; never official generalization/locality probes or evaluation failures
